احقوقفت (form XII)
# اِحْقَوْقَفْتُ (iḥqawqaftu) /iħ.qaw.qaf.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِحْقَوْقَفَ (iḥqawqafa)
# اِحْقَوْقَفْتَ (iḥqawqafta) /iħ.qaw.qaf.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِحْقَوْقَفَ (iḥqawqafa)
# اِحْقَوْقَفْتِ (iḥqawqafti) /iħ.qaw.qaf.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِحْقَوْقَفَ (iḥqawqafa)
# اِحْقَوْقَفَتْ (iḥqawqafat) /iħ
